description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said Terrance Ferguson will not be designated to return from injured reserve this week.
items.impact: Ferguson remains without a clear timetable to return. Tyler Higbee and Colby Parkinson will continue to lead a committee of tight ends.
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will not return to practice this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colby Parkinson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parkinson has played a bigger role in recent weeks. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nate Landman was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Landman remains in concussion protocol.
items.title: Nate Landman (concussion) logs full practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Trent McDuffie returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: This was McDuffie's first practice since he injured his groin during a Week 6 practice. He was limited in his return.
items.title: Trent McDuffie (groin) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dylan Sampson was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sampson made his return in Week 7. He remains in the flex streaming conversation.
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyle Hamilton did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hamilton will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Kyle Hamilton (knee) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ben Skowronek was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Skowronek remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kincaid is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Ravens. He'll remain a TE1 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (chest) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans claimed Emari Demercado off waivers.
items.impact: Demercado will remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Emari Demercado claimed off waivers by Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Spencer Brown did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brown misses the first practice out of the bye week. He'll need to continue to be monitored.
items.title: Spencer Brown (back) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Waddle's status for Week 8 against the Chiefs is up in the air.
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Pat Surtain II is practicing in full for Week 8 against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Surtain is on track to make his return from a multi-week absence.
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) practicing in full for Week 8

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: George Pickens was limited in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
items.impact: Pickens appeared to have picked up the hamstring injury in Monday's game. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Treylon Burks was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Burks was limited out of the bye week with a foot injury. He is in line for an expanded role if he is healthy with Terry McLaurin out for the season.
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Javon Kinlaw missed practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kinlaw's status is uncertain for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.title: Javon Kinlaw (knee) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saquon Barkley did not participate in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
items.impact: Barkley returned in Week 7 against the Cowboys, but appeared to get banged up again. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) misses walkthrough practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks did not participate in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
items.impact: Wicks was sidelined in Week 7 against the Cowboys. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeVonta Smith did not participate in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
items.impact: Smith was sidelined in Week 7 against the Cowboys. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses walkthrough Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jihaad Campbell did not participate in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
items.impact: Campbell will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Allgeier is dealing with a toe injury. Jeremiyah Love (ankle) returned to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday.
items.title: Tyler Allgeier (toe) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Michael Wilson was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wilson was on the practice field wearing a non-contact jersey. He should still be on track to be good to go this week.
items.title: Michael Wilson (ribs) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins claimed OL Christian Haynes off waivers from the Seahawks.
items.impact: It was announced that the Ravens had claimed Haynes off waivers. The Dolphins had a higher claim and were awarded Haynes.
items.title: Christian Haynes claimed off waivers by Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ian Thomas was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thomas remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.
items.title: Ian Thomas (shoulder) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brock Bowers was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Warren notes that Bowers was also limited last Wednesday then was a full participant in practice the next two days.
items.title: Brock Bowers (calf) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue to their 53-man roster from the practice squad.
items.impact: Dameon Pierce was placed on the injured list as the corresponding move. Blue will remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Jaydon Blue signs with Eagles' 53-man roster
